sentences.text: Redondavenator belongs to the sphenosuchians, a group of early crocodylomorphs that are distant relatives of today's crocodiles.
The skull of the single known specimen measures at least 60 centimeters in length.
This animal holds the record for the largest crocodylomorph discovered from the Triassic era.
Its upper jaw featured two unusually large teeth, the fourth and fifth ones.
Sterling Nesbitt and colleagues formally described the genus in 2005, naming the type species after Quay County.
Strong shoulder bones suggest the creature was built for powerful movement.
Scientists believe it acted as a major land predator following the disappearance of rauisuchians.
This animal is classified within the broader group known as Crocodylomorpha.
